texts.value: Converts O-phosphoseryl-tRNA(Sec) to selenocysteinyl-tRNA(Sec) required for selenoprotein biosynthesis
Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis; selenocysteinyl-tRNA(Sec) biosynthesis; selenocysteinyl-tRNA(Sec) from L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) (archaeal/eukaryal route): step 2/2

Homotetramer formed by a catalytic dimer and a non-catalytic dimer serving as a binding platform that orients tRNASec for catalysis (PubMed:19608919). Each tetramer binds the CCA ends of two tRNAs which point to the active sites of the catalytic dimer (PubMed:19608919). Component of a complex composed of SEPHS1, SEPHS2, SEPSECS and TRNAU1AP (PubMed:16508009, PubMed:28414460)
Primarily expressed in liver, pancreas, kidney and lung. Overexpressed in PHA-stimulated T-cells
